releaseNotes: 3.0.0: whitelist + blocklist with packs, schedules, per-site daily limits, a whole-day screen-time budget, "ask a parent for more time", usage report with chart and CSV export, cross-device sync, PIN quick unlock, a family new-tab dashboard, frame-aware enforcement, PBKDF2 password storage kept out of cloud sync, and a full Arabic RTL interface.
